text:
alex_cs: Heads-up — HelioApps kickoff today. They want a short, customer-facing checklist we can hand to their engineers for onboarding (focus: caching, batching, streaming). Need something non-technical for PMs + a one-page config snippet for their infra team.
maria_csm: Perfect. I'll own the PM-friendly copy. Can we include 3 suggested defaults (low/mid/high) for cache TTLs and batch sizes? They care about renewal risk if latency spikes in first 7 days. :alarm_clock:
owen_sre: +1. For infra team, recommend: prefix caching enabled, KV cache size suggestion, streaming chunk size ~256 tokens, max_batch=32 for GPUs, fallback synchronous path at max_latency=250ms. I'll paste a minimal example below.
owen_sre: ```json
{
  "cache": {
    "enabled": true,
    "strategy": "prefix",
    "ttl_seconds": 120,
    "kv_size_mb": 64
  },
  "batching": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_batch_size": 32,
    "batch_timeout_ms": 20
  },
  "streaming": {
    "chunk_tokens": 256,
    "max_concurrent_streams": 8
  },
  "slo": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 200,
    "fallback_to_sync_after_ms": 250
  }
}
```
tara_support: This looks good. For the PM doc, can we translate those numbers into plain guidance? e.g., "Low: conservative TTL (30s), batch small (8) — best for unpredictable prompt lengths; High: aggressive TTL (300s), batch 32 — best for stable prompt patterns." That helps flag renewal risk if they pick aggressive settings without warmup.
alex_cs: Exactly. Also add a short checklist for enablement touchpoints: day0 smoke test (end-to-end), day1 traffic priming (prefill 10-20 queries per top user), day3 telemetry review, day7 renewal-risk check (usage, error spikes, latency). Keep it 1 page.
maria_csm: Draft for PMs (short): "1) Run Day0 smoke: verify end-to-end sample prompts, enable streaming and confirm partial tokens arrive within 100ms. 2) Prime the model: send 10 representative queries per heavy user to warm caches. 3) Observe Telemetry: check tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cache hit% (goal: >40% within 48h). 4) If p95 > 300ms or cache hit < 20% at day3, flag CSM for escalation." Thoughts?
owen_sre: Add a lightweight troubleshooting block: common causes and commands.
owen_sre: ```bash
# check cache hit rate
redwoodctl metrics query --customer helioapps --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 24h

# tail streaming errors
redwoodctl logs tail --customer helioapps --filter "stream_error" --since 1h

# simulate batch load
ab -n 100 -c 8 http://staging-helioapps/redwood-proxy/generate
```
tara_support: Love the troubleshooting tips. Also include an ops-friendly escalation matrix: CSM -> Support on-call -> SRE if latency persists after tuning. And note common quick fixes: reduce max_batch_size to 16, lower batch_timeout_ms to 10ms, or disable prefix cache to avoid cold-key thrashing.
alex_cs: One more thing — feedback capture. We should add a tiny survey snippet they can attach to their PMs: 3 quick questions after day7: 1) Are responses meeting quality expectations? 2) Any latency >500ms? 3) Did you notice partial tokens missing in streaming? Provide yes/no + short comment. We'll pipe results to our CS dashboard.
maria_csm: I'll convert this into a one-pager and a short email template. Will also upload the config snippet into their onboarding folder and link to the troubleshooting commands.
devops-bot: scheduled job: "prefill-run" for helioapps at 2025-06-12T15:04:00Z — status: queued :gear:
tara_support: Great — let's assign owners: Maria = PM copy + email template, Owen = infra snippet + troubleshooting, Alex = enablement checklist + renewal-risk triggers. I'll own follow-up audit at day3.
alex_cs: Thanks team. I'll post the one-pager to the HelioApps workspace and link to this thread. If anyone has a user story or edge case (very short prompts, heavy streaming interactivity), drop it here before EOD.
maria_csm: Adding note: For low-touch customers recommend conservative defaults. For PLG-scale customers: aggressive caching + warm pools. We'll include both paths.
owen_sre: FYI: if they run on CPU-only private deployment, reduce max_batch_size to 8 and set batch_timeout_ms to 50 to avoid latency regressions.
tara_support: Closing loop — I'll run the day0 checklist with HelioApps at 16:00 PST.
alex_cs: Awesome. Thread saved. :white_check_mark:
